segments.contextBefore: The following code shows how to set up a simple point (the default [`emitterShape`](caemitterlayer/emittershape.md) is [`point`](caemitterlayeremittershape/point.md)) particle emitter.
segments.contextAfter:
```swift
let emitterLayer = CAEmitterLayer()
    
emitterLayer.emitterPosition = CGPoint(x: 320, y: 320)
    
let cell = CAEmitterCell()
cell.birthRate = 100
cell.lifetime = 10
cell.velocity = 100
cell.scale = 0.1
    
cell.emissionRange = CGFloat.pi * 2.0
cell.contents = UIImage(named: "RadialGradient.png")!.cgImage
    
emitterLayer.emitterCells = [cell]
    
view.layer.addSublayer(emitterLayer)
```
